name: Rock River
blurb: Rock River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: A short trip with a long mandatory land carry around Horicon Dam. The water-trail guide identifies the carry from Legion Park to Kiwanis Park; River Bend Park is farther downstream. Markers show approximate access areas. The 1.2-mile preliminary river distance does not describe the walking route or carry time.
sections.routeReview: The water-trail guide describes a long carry from Legion Park to Kiwanis Park. City sources confirm upstream and downstream boat access. The land carry and exact shoreline connections are not drawn; no continuous dotted path crosses Horicon Dam.

notices.title: Horicon Dam: long portage required
notices.text: Leave the river above Horicon Dam and use the documented land carry from Legion Park to Kiwanis Park. Confirm the signed route and whether you can carry your boat before launching. River Bend Park is downstream of Kiwanis Park.
notices.sourceName: Dodge County tourism — Rock River Water Trail

notices.title: Stay clear of Horicon Dam
notices.text: Wisconsin DNR warns of dangerous currents and a high-voltage electric fish barrier at the Horicon dam. Do not approach or paddle through it. The access map does not show the carry route.

sections.notes: A long river-and-lake trip through Lake Sinissippi with a mandatory land carry around Hustisford Dam at Lions Park. Downstream reaches can contain fallen trees and long gaps between public access. Markers show approximate facilities. The 26.7-mile planning distance is preliminary and does not include carry time.

notices.title: Hustisford Dam: portage required
notices.text: Use the signed carry at Lions Park to go around Hustisford Dam. Check its take-out, downstream launch and suitability for your boat during the shuttle. The guide describes roughly 17 miles from Hustisford to Harnischfeger Park with limited access and possible log jams.
notices.sourceName: Dodge County tourism — Rock River Water Trail

sections.difficulty: Open-water lake crossing — challenging in wind and boat traffic
sections.notes: This trip continues from the Rock River into Lake Koshkonong and exits at Newville. The water-trail guide classifies the lake crossing as challenging because of its broad open water and motorboat traffic. Avoid high winds and approaching storms. Arrange a vehicle shuttle and plan for active paddling; river current alone does not determine the crossing time. The existing 11.7-mile planning distance is preliminary USGS geometry, not a surveyed or approved navigation route.

sections.notes: This trip requires a land portage around Janesville Central Dam. The January 2026 FERC assessment documents the west-shore take-out, an approximately 500-foot city portage trail and downstream put-in. It also discusses proposed ramp repairs; completion has not been confirmed. The preliminary 1.8-mile river distance excludes walking and carry time.
sections.routeReview: Confirm the portage is open and usable with the City of Janesville and the operator before launching. Inspect the signed exit, path and re-entry during your shuttle. Do not paddle through Janesville Central Dam. Exact carry routes and shoreline connections are not drawn; this access map is not a continuous floating route.

notices.title: Janesville Central Dam: portage required
notices.text: FERC documents a gravel take-out on the west shore upstream of the powerhouse, with an approximately 500-foot city-owned portage trail and downstream put-in. Follow signed access outside restricted dam areas. Check that your boat and gear can be carried; the map does not identify the exact carry entrance or walking path.

notices.title: Check portage condition before launching
notices.text: The 2026 assessment discusses repairs to the concrete re-entry ramp as proposed work. It does not confirm completion. Confirm current access and ramp condition with the city and operator before attempting this trip. If the carry is closed or unusable, choose a different section.
